summary: SK Telecom filed a Form 6-K reporting that its board approved the disposal of 24,481,427 shares of SK Horizon, a subsidiary to be created via spin-off from SK Broadband, to KKR (Quantum Asia Holdings II) and IMM Consortium (Korea Digital Infra) for KRW 1.88 trillion. The board unanimously approved August 27, 2026; closing expected March 4, 2027, subject to regulatory approvals and spin-off completion. Post-transaction SK Telecom holds 63.03%, then 51% after a separate primary subscription raising ~KRW 1.2 trillion. Transaction aggregates ~KRW 3.08 trillion; overhang from post-deal minority stakes; watch regulatory timeline and subscription price changes.
